notes: Expected values come from a forward-only oracle plus central finite differences (h=1e-5); the reference's exact gradients agree with them to 2.2e-8 worst case over all 191 programs (gate 1e-6). wrong_unbroadcast sums broadcast grads over leading axes only (fails the (B,1)-(B,C) keepdims probe); wrong_naive_lse has no max shift in logsumexp (OverflowError on the |logit|~900 cases); wrong_recursive builds the topological order recursively (RecursionError on the 20000-op chain only); wrong_stale_grad keeps intermediate grads on the nodes across backward() calls (first trips on the two-root reduction probe, case 12, then every multi-root program); wrong_no_zero_grad accumulates parameter grads across SGD steps (step 1 still uses clean grads; the trace diverges at step 2); wrong_matmul_vec keeps the axis inserted for a rank-1 matmul operand. slow.py finds each node's consumers by scanning all nodes (quadratic): killed by the validator's own 10 s limit on the chain. The reference runs the whole hidden set in about 1 s. Repair round: case 191 (wide_case) is a 2000-element leaf through 500 broadcast/elementwise ops, + a (40,) bias, @ a (40,3) weight, into a sum; its expected gradient is exact (per-element forward-mode tangents plus a closed-form tail), and it exists so that a finite-difference backward cannot fit the limit: cheat_fd.py (reference forward, backward = central FD over the replayed graph, h=1e-5) passes all 191 other programs but times out here (the reference adds ~0.3 s). wrong_rg_always sets requires_grad=True on every op result (the driver now reports requires_grad per node and the validator recomputes it from the operands). wrong_mutate_inputs clobbers the caller's params and X after training (the driver snapshots the inputs). leak_argv.py only works if it finds the oracle in its own, parent or grandparent argv or in a v190-* temp file: the validator is a stub that writes its body to a 0600 temp file and exec()s a short loader that deletes it first, so the validator process's argv no longer carries the oracle (the previous build leaked it; this probe passes against commit 7cde689).
